interpretation: Exploratory feasibility/model-selection evidence only; the 160-block development schedule is not powered confirmatory evidence.

gates.fit_pass: All 60 checkpoints have finite receipts, identical matched run configuration and data identities, one completed epoch, and development-only scope.
gates.development_match_pass: Only after complete fit_pass; all 160 scheduled paired blocks replay; report both games, both controls, all forfeits/censors, seed-clustered uncertainty, and measured fit/search compute.
gates.superiority_claim: Never from this panel; requires a new, frozen, independently reviewed confirmatory run on the unopened V08 schedule and beating both controls at its meaningful margin.

p_hacking_boundary: Any hyperparameter or objective change uses development/selection only, creates a new versioned specification before its next fit, and leaves V08 unopened.
